decisions.reason: The GPIO3-to-GPIO5 change is already fully represented by this Requirement's message-291 MODIFY to enable_gpio; no additional update or removal is needed.
Changing the GPIO that controls the shared 5V rail does not change the LED board's required count or board-level state.
The GPIO remapping does not alter the sensor board's role as a connector hub.
The source changes 5V_EN and other GPIO assignments, not the standalone USB-powered 3.3V rail behavior.
The interboard connector still carries the same named 5V_EN, SCL0, and SPI signals; remapping their MCU GPIOs does not change the connector or pinout state.
The GPIO remapping does not change the AXP2101 power source, required rails, or battery power path.
The source does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or its normal-operation role.
The source remaps 5V_EN, SCL0, and SPI MOSI but does not change the retained sleep policy or wake-source assignments.
This Requirement already has a complete message-291 MODIFY recording 5V_EN on GPIO5, SCL0 on GPIO38, and SPI MOSI on GPIO26.
The GPIO changes do not affect the battery connector's type, contacts, accessibility, or unresolved physical pin order.
The source changes MCU signal assignments and does not alter the separate interboard power connector or its matching-pin-order rule.
The 5V_EN GPIO remapping does not change the separate charge-status LED circuit, connector, resistor, or population requirements.
